intro: The Sienna TV Unit keeps things simple. No more messy wires or bulky furniture—just a clean, compact design that fits your TV, stores your essentials, and looks good in any space.

features.title: Perfect fit for TVs up to 65 inches
features.text: A sleek, spacious surface accommodates TVs up to 65 inches, creating a seamless entertainment setup for an immersive viewing experience.

features.title: Concealed wire management for a clean look
features.text: No more messy cables—thoughtful wire management keeps your setup neat, ensuring an uncluttered, polished living space.

features.title: Push-to-open shutters for seamless access
features.text: No bulky handles—just a simple push to open and close storage compartments, making it easy to grab what you need without interrupting your space’s sleek look.

features.title: Compact design tailored for urban homes
features.text: Designed to fit comfortably in apartments and modern homes, the compact build saves space while still offering plenty of storage for your media essentials.

features.title: Dual-tone finish for added elegance
features.text: The warm wood and grey finish work well with any décor, adding a modern touch without overpowering your space.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
